os:store.os:value: #[output application/json --- { payload: payload, payloadType: typeOf(payload) as String, mime: payload.^mimeType, attrClass: attributes.^class, attrKeys: keysOf(attributes) map ($ as String) orderBy $, method: attributes.method, taskIdIsUuid: (attributes.taskId default "") matches /[0-9a-f-]{36}/, contextIdIsUuid: (attributes.contextId default "") matches /[0-9a-f-]{36}/, headerKeys: keysOf(attributes.headers default {}) map ($ as String) orderBy $, attrs: write((attributes - "headers") orderBy ((v, k) -> k as String), "application/json") replace /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/ with "<uuid>" replace /:[0-9]{4,5}"/ with ':<port>"', ctype: attributes.headers."content-type" }]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- {kind: "task", id: attributes.taskId, contextId: attributes.contextId, status: {state: "completed", message: {kind: "message", role: "agent", messageId: "m-reply", parts: [{kind: "text", text: "done"}]}}, artifacts: [{artifactId: "a1", name: "result", parts: [{kind: "text", text: "artifact text"}]}]}]

a2a:send-message.a2a:message: #[output application/json --- {message: {kind: "message", role: "user", messageId: "m-1", parts: [{kind: "text", text: vars.text}]}}]
